answer: New identities clear a customs trellis before voting. Each posts a $30 copper bond, locked by the protocol, and receives an opal audit token naming one random past epoch. The protocol replays that epoch and checks the identity's signed trace; a mismatch burns the $30 bond and ejects the identity. Audits accumulate, so an honest agent replays its own record free while a fresh puppet has no history to replay. Each extra puppet needs its own $30 bond, its own device-bound trace, and its own audit trail, so the attacker's cost rises $30 per identity with no bulk discount.
